subject: Recast of usage tiers and Exhibit B adjustments - BluePeak
messages:
From: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@bluepeak.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recast request: usage tiers + Exhibit B adjustments

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the call earlier — our finance and ML ops teams did a deeper review of the draft order form and we need to request a recast of how usage tiers are defined in Exhibit B. Two specific asks:

1) Move 1e-2 and 1e-3 GPU usage into a separate "infrequent-burst" pool so we don't over-provision reserved units.
2) Re-align the monthly token-based overage credit so it smooths across spikes (we'd like a rolling 30-day smoothing credit rather than per-invoice true-up).

These changes will also require a short SOW edit to the throughput ramp table — our engineering lead flagged dates that won't match the original milestones. Can you share an amendment draft we can review with legal?

We'd like to finalize before the end of August; is that feasible?

Regards,
Erin Shaw
Head of Platform Partnerships
BluePeak Analytics
[Attachment: BP-usage-summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recast request: usage tiers + Exhibit B adjustments

Hi Erin — thanks for the clear summary. Yes, we can do a recast and propose a few paths to preserve your cost predictability while keeping throughput guarantees intact.

Plan:
- I'll draft an amendment that: (a) introduces an "Infrequent Burst" exhibit for the 1e-2/1e-3 usage, (b) changes the overage credit to a 30-day rolling smoothing mechanism, and (c) updates the SOW ramp milestones with the new dates your eng team suggested.
- I'll include two pricing options in the amendment: a tiered blended rate and a fixed committed top-up, so you can pick which matches your procurement approach.

Looping in Marissa for implementation timeline and Vivek for billing/credits. We'll produce a redline by EOD tomorrow and run it through legal (Laura).

Would you be open to a 30-min sync Thursday to walk through the amendment? If yes, propose 10:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recast request: usage tiers + Exhibit B adjustments

Team — forwarding BluePeak's asks. Key actions:

- Marissa: review SOW milestone changes vs. implementation capacity. BluePeak wants later milestone dates for the throughput ramp; confirm we can meet their new timeline (Erin will send the revised schedule inline).
- Laura: we need a short amendment + redline covering (1) exhibit defining "Infrequent Burst" usage, (2) new 30-day rolling smoothing credit language, and (3) exhibit B ramp table edits. We prefer to keep the indemnities and data controls unchanged.
- Vivek: please run the two pricing options (blended tier vs. fixed top-up) and include example monthly invoices and sample smoothing credit calculation.

Attached is my first-pass draft amendment + an Excel that maps old vs. proposed exhibit lines. Please put redlines/comments directly on the doc. Need legal sign-off by EOD Thursday to hit BluePeak's August target.

Attachments:
- BP-Amendment-draft-redlines.docx (docx)
- Exhibit_B_recast.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Recast request: usage tiers + Exhibit B adjustments

Karthik / team — I reviewed the draft and attached a redlined PDF with in-line comments. High-level flags:

1) "Infrequent Burst" definition: great start, but we should add explicit eviction language for KV cache state if the burst is >15 minutes to avoid resource contention across tenants.
2) Rolling 30-day smoothing credit: legal is fine if commercial approves the math; add a clause limiting historical averaging window to 6 months for auditability.
3) SOW ramp table: suggest adding a short acceptance criteria bullet at each milestone to avoid scope creep disputes.
4) Pricing options: if commercial picks blended tier, add a floor on the minimum monthly commit during the first 3 months.

I attached: BP-Amendment-redline-LEGAL.pdf (redline) and a one-page summary with proposed contract language snippets for quick insertion. I'll mark which clauses are non-negotiable vs. commercial flex.

Please review and let me know if any of you want me to take the next pass before we send to BluePeak.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BP-Amendment-redline-LEGAL.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Recast request: usage tiers + Exhibit B adjustments

Thanks Karthik and Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed redline. The legal team had two quick asks (both minor):

- Move the 6-month historical averaging audit clause to the appendix (so procurement can sign off without long review).
- For the eviction language, could we soften to "best efforts" with a 24-hour notice for scheduled maintenance that would impact burst availability? Our platform team prefers the operational flexibility.

If those edits are non-substantive to you, we can accept the amendment draft and route for DocuSign. I can sign once the DocuSign link is live — we'll need the amendment and revised Exhibit B bundled.

Would you mind sending the final packaged amendment + DocuSign link by Friday?

Best,
Erin
Head of Platform Partnerships
BluePeak Analytics
